newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania c.bank reserves at over $1.0 bln-governor.
newsitem.headline: Romania c.bank reserves at over $1.0 bln-governor.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) governor said on Wednesday the BNR's foreign exchange reserves now stood at over $1.0 billion, up from $853 million in March.
"Over the past days, our reserves were constantly over $1.0 billion. We bought $50 million last week and some $20 million over the past two days," Mugur Isarescu told Reuters.
In March the reserves stood at $853.7, this compared with 697.7 million by end-February.
Isarescu said the increase followed tougher monetary policies imposed by the BNR and a better functioning of the foreign exchange market.
Trading on the country's foreign exchange market has revived since February when the BNR restored local dealer licenses to 24 commercial banks which along with other four banks act as market makers.
"The market is functioning well and is extremely liquid. The foreign exchange market could turn into a big incentive for the foreign investors," Isarescu said.
Latest BNR data bank showed interbank volume at $21.6 million on Tuesday, when overall trading was $47.7 million.
This compares with an average daily interbank volume of $7.0 million in March when average overall trading amounted to $22.7 million.
